# fonts

The font files the Corral web build embeds, used as `CRAFT_FONTS_DIR` (see
`vendor/corral/crates/text/build.rs`): Inter (Regular, Italic, SemiBold, Bold) and Noto Sans
Georgian. Each family keeps its SIL Open Font License 1.1 text next to it (`OFL.txt`); the
attribution table is in `src-tauri/resources/licenses/fonts-ofl/`.
